## About GeoNarrator Studio

GeoNarrator Studio is a no-code 3D scrollytelling map editor that enables users to create stunning, interactive map-based stories without writing any code.

## Core Features

- **3D Map Visualization**: Powered by Mapbox GL for beautiful, cinematic 3D maps
- **Scrollytelling Editor**: Create scroll-driven narratives that guide users through geographic stories
- **Drag-and-Drop Interface**: Intuitive scene management with visual drag-and-drop controls
- **Cinematic Camera Controls**: Control zoom, tilt, rotation, and bearing for dramatic map perspectives
- **Real-Time Preview**: Instantly preview your story as you build it
- **No-Code Platform**: No programming knowledge required
- **Export/Import**: Save and share projects as JSON files

## Use Cases

GeoNarrator Studio is ideal for:
- Journalists creating data-driven geographic stories
- Educators building interactive geography lessons
- Travel bloggers documenting journeys with visual narratives
- Historians presenting location-based historical content
- Researchers visualizing geospatial data
- Marketers creating location-based brand stories

## Technical Stack

- Next.js 14 (React Framework)
- TypeScript
- Mapbox GL JS (3D Maps)
- Framer Motion (Animations)
- Tailwind CSS (Styling)
- Zustand (State Management)
- DnD Kit (Drag and Drop)

## How It Works

1. **Create Scenes**: Add scenes/chapters to your story
2. **Position Camera**: Use the visual controls to set the perfect map view
3. **Write Narrative**: Add titles and descriptions for each scene
4. **Preview**: Switch to preview mode to experience the scrollytelling
5. **Export**: Save your project as JSON or publish online

## API and Integration

GeoNarrator Studio projects can be exported as JSON and integrated into:
- Custom websites
- React applications
- Static site generators
- CMS platforms
